sn48.50:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.
sn48.50:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi:
sn48.50:1.4: “yo so sāriputta, ariyasāvako tathāgate ekantagato, abhippasanno, api nu so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā”ti?
sn48.50:2.1: yo so bhante, ariyasāvako tathāgate ekantagato abhippasanno, na so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā.
sn48.50:2.2: saddhassa hi bhante, ariyasāvakassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: “yaṃ āraddhaviriyo viharissati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu.
sn48.50:2.3: yaṃ hissa bhante, viriyaṃ tadassa viriyindriyaṃ.
sn48.50:3.1: saddhassa hi bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhaviriyassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: “yaṃ satimā bhavissati paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
sn48.50:3.2: yā hissa bhante, sati, tadassa satindriyaṃ.
sn48.50:4.1: saddhassa hi bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhaviriyassa upaṭṭhitasatino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: “yaṃ vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhissati samādhiṃ, labhissati cittassekaggataṃ.
sn48.50:4.2: yo hissa bhante, samādhi tadassa samādhindriyaṃ.
sn48.50:5.1: saddhassa hi bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhaviriyassa upaṭṭhitasatino samāhitacittassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: “yaṃ evaṃ jānissati
sn48.50:5.3: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn48.50:5.4: avijjāyatveva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho, santametaṃ padaṃ, paṇītametaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ
sn48.50:5.5: sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ,
sn48.50:5.6: yā hissa bhante, paññā tadassa paññindriyaṃ,
sn48.50:6.1: sa kho so bhante, ariyasāvako evaṃ padahitvā padahitvā evaṃ saritvā saritvā evaṃ samādahitvā samādahitvā evaṃ pajānitvā pajānitvā evaṃ abhisaddahati:
sn48.50:6.2: “ime kho te dhammā ye’me pubbe sutāva ahesuṃ.
sn48.50:6.3: te’dānāhaṃ etarahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca ativijjha passāmī”ti.
sn48.50:6.4: yā hi’ssa bhante, saddhā tadassa saddhindriyanti.
